g.text: Core Data Model - Entity Relationship Diagram
Multi-Tenant SaaS Architecture with Hybrid Database Strategy
PK = Primary Key | FK = Foreign Key | ref = Application reference
Logical Isolation (Free/Standard): tenantUuid column in User table filters data in shared PostgreSQL databases.
MongoDB collections enforce isolation via application-level ownership checks through userId references.
Physical Isolation (Enterprise): Dedicated Cloud SQL instances + dedicated MongoDB databases per tenant.
